behavior: Training editor opens the routine music selector in My playlists with the current routine selection and remembered playlist shuffle.
Use for routine updates the editor draft only. Save routine stores the optional soundtrack inside the existing account-scoped routine record. Neither choosing nor saving starts music.
Explicit Play routine music starts one continuous Apple Music queue independently of the workout timer. Phase changes do not select songs.
Saved routine music is displayed separately from the actual current global player queue. Shuffle on a saved routine and shuffle on an active queue are separate preferences.
Selections and metadata use a bounded strict whitelist. Missing or invalid legacy soundtrack values normalize to null; old timed playlist fields are never converted automatically.
Existing local/device round assignments, durations, volumes, Advanced alerts and legacy choices remain separate and preserved.
Manual Play reserves companion ownership before awaiting checked local audio cleanup. Later timer phases cannot restart saved round audio while that queue is reserved or owned.
Background retires pending new start intents without stopping an already owned playing queue. Foreground never retries the retired intent.
Picker request IDs, routine generations, blur/unmount and connection retirement reject stale selection callbacks.
limitations: Automatic Work/Rest song assignment is not restored or enabled; this is a continuous routine soundtrack.
The native17 host was compiled and checked separately at the prior c5a017ca source. This JS delta still requires an overlay/export and UI check before the next delivery.
MusicKit account playback and the owner’s actual library artwork must be verified on a fresh physical-device candidate; automated tests use controlled native/remote fakes.
